## Summary
Parker, your recent performance shows a solid upward trend in hours per RO, reaching 1.32 on May 25 and maintaining a consistent CSI of 943. Your efforts are clearly paying off, as evidenced by the increasing MTD hours, which have climbed to 286.8.

## What's Working
- Consistent CSI scores of 943 over the last three days (May 28-30) indicate high customer satisfaction levels. 😊
- Your hours per RO have improved, with a peak of 1.32 on May 25, showing effective upselling and service recommendations.
- Alignment upsell percentages are strong, peaking at 34.6% on May 20, which is above the industry average and indicates effective communication of service needs.
- Tire service percentages are also noteworthy, reaching 21.1% on May 30, suggesting you're successfully identifying tire needs during service write-ups.
- Your RO count has been robust, with 224 ROs recorded on May 30, showcasing your ability to manage a high volume of customer interactions.

## Where to Focus
- **Valvoline Upsell**: Currently at 92.0% on May 30, while this is a strong percentage, it has fluctuated significantly over the month, dipping to 28.3% on May 15. Consistently upselling maintenance services like Valvoline can enhance customer retention and profitability. Aim for a steady rate above 35% each week. 
- **RO Aging**: You have several open ROs that are aging, particularly RO 777735 (9 days old). Addressing these promptly will help maintain service flow and customer satisfaction. A follow-up call to the customer can expedite resolution.
- **Daily Average Hours**: Your daily average hours are currently at 0.00, indicating a need to focus on daily performance tracking. Aim for a daily average of at least 1.25 hours to align with dealership goals.
- **Tire Service Percentage**: Although it peaked at 21.1%, it has been inconsistent. Focus on consistently promoting tire services during customer interactions to maintain higher percentages throughout the month.
- **Customer Follow-Up**: Work on improving your follow-up process to ensure customers are informed about their vehicle status, especially for aging ROs.

## Action Items for This Week
1. Follow up with the customer on RO 777735 to expedite resolution and ensure the vehicle is serviced promptly.
2. Set a daily goal to achieve at least 1.25 hours per RO by identifying upsell opportunities during customer write-ups.
3. Focus on promoting Valvoline services to increase your upsell percentage back above 35% this week.

## Open Work to Push
- RO 777902 (2 days old) needs customer communication regarding the alternator and battery replacement. 
- RO 777876 (3 days old) requires an update to the customer about the status of the catalytic converter work.
- RO 777735 (9 days old) is aging and needs immediate attention to avoid further delays. 

Keep up the great work, Parker! Your commitment to improving metrics is evident, and with a few adjustments, you can reach even greater heights. 🚀
